title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #6

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which element is called Akash? (1 mark)
   A. Earth
   B. Water
   C. Fire
   D. Space

2. Which faith do Tulsi and the Ganga belong to most closely? (1 mark)
   A. Buddhism
   B. Jainism
   C. Hinduism
   D. Sikhism

3. Which faith honours the Bodhi tree most because of the Buddha? (1 mark)
   A. Buddhism
   B. Islam
   C. Jainism
   D. Sikhism

4. In the seed activity, why do we plant two tins? (1 mark)
   A. Because one tin is too small
   B. To make it look neat
   C. To compare seeds with water and seeds without water
   D. To use up all the soil

5. What was the name of Siddhartha's father? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Amar Das
   B. King Suddhodana
   C. King Dasharatha
   D. Hiranyakashipu

6. What does Ahimsa mean? (1 mark)
   A. Eating late
   B. Paying taxes
   C. Telling stories
   D. Not hurting any living being

7. What lesson does the Narsimha story teach? (1 mark)
   A. Pride and cruelty do not last
   B. Kings never make mistakes
   C. Bullies always win
   D. Faith is useless

8. What does the word Guru mean? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. A river
   C. A teacher who leads from darkness to light
   D. A soldier

9. If a classmate is being bullied, which teaching helps? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore it
   B. Stand up for the child who is troubled
   C. Join the bullies
   D. Laugh

10. Which of these is one of Parshvanath's four rules? (1 mark)
   A. Satya, always speak the truth
   B. Be proud
   C. Take what you like
   D. Wealth at any cost

11. In which city was Parshvanath born? (1 mark)
   A. Lumbini
   B. Lahore
   C. Nairobi
   D. Varanasi

12. Which pair is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Ramayan: Buddhism
   B. Dhammapada: Sikhism
   C. Uttaradhyayan Sutra: Jainism
   D. Kalpasutra: Hinduism

13. What is aarti? (1 mark)
   A. Eating
   B. Reading a map
   C. Waving a lamp in front of the murti while singing
   D. Painting

14. What is a Mandir? (1 mark)
   A. A market
   B. A school
   C. A river
   D. A Hindu place of worship

15. What does the Twameva prayer teach us about God? (1 mark)
   A. God cares for us like a parent and friend
   B. God is only a king
   C. God is a stranger
   D. God is far and angry

16. When can Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva be said? (1 mark)
   A. Only at a wedding
   B. Only at a funeral
   C. Before meals and in the evening
   D. Never

17. Which of these should you do first when learning a mantra? (1 mark)
   A. Listen to a teacher or recording for correct sounds
   B. Skip the words
   C. Say it very fast
   D. Guess the words

18. Which is fair play in a game? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. Pushing
   C. Tripping others
   D. Following the rules even when nobody is looking

19. Which is dishonest? (1 mark)
   A. Owning up to a mistake
   B. Copying another person's work and calling it your own
   C. Returning a lost item
   D. Doing your own homework

20. What does the word yoga mean? (1 mark)
   A. To run
   B. To sleep
   C. To join or unite
   D. To eat

21. What is Bhastrika called in English? (1 mark)
   A. The shining forehead breath
   B. The moon pose
   C. The hare pose
   D. The bellows breath

22. Which pose do you start Sasankasana from? (1 mark)
   A. Vajra Asana
   B. Standing
   C. A handstand
   D. Lying down

23. Which pose is called the hare or moon pose? (1 mark)
   A. Bhastrika
   B. Vajra Asana
   C. Sasankasana
   D. Kapaal Bhaati

24. Because God sees all we do, what should we do? (1 mark)
   A. Cheat
   B. Hide
   C. Be honest even when alone
   D. Complain

25. Which king protected a dove in a well-known story? (1 mark)
   A. Harishchandra
   B. Ravan
   C. Hiranyakashipu
   D. King Shibi

26. Which is a kind of prayer? (1 mark)
   A. A school race
   B. A race
   C. A song of prayer called a bhajan
   D. A market

27. What does Punarjanam mean? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A river
   C. Rebirth
   D. A festival

28. Which stories are told about Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. That it is the night of Shiva and Parvati's wedding or of Shiva's great dance
   B. That it is a harvest festival of Kenya
   C. That it is the birth of the Buddha
   D. That it is a Jain festival of forgiveness

29. What is Paryushan Parva mainly about? (1 mark)
   A. Racing
   B. Feasts only
   C. Wealth
   D. Prayer, self-control and forgiveness

30. What is the Indian name for Thursday? (1 mark)
   A. Shanivaar
   B. Ravivaar
   C. Guruvaar
   D. Shukravaar

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. What does the name Narsimha mean? (2 marks)

32. Name two parts of a Mandir. (2 marks)

33. Choose one teaching from an Enlightened Being and say how you can follow it at school. (3 marks)

34. Explain what Maha Shivratri teaches. (4 marks)

35. Name the three prayers studied in this lesson. (2 marks)

36. Name the months of the Indian traditional calendar in which Maha Shivratri and Paryushan fall. (3 marks)

37. Name the two Buddhist scriptures in this lesson. (2 marks)

38. Draw and label a simple Mandir. Name four features you would show. (4 marks)

39. Which day is Shanivaar and which planet is it linked with? (2 marks)

40. State three reasons why the Saraswati Vandana is said by students. (3 marks)

41. Describe how to make a decorated calendar. (4 marks)

42. Write three ways of conserving water in the community. (3 marks)

43. Match four scriptures with their faiths. (4 marks)

44. Give two lessons of the Bal Kaand. (2 marks)

45. Why should we breathe slowly during asanas? (2 marks)

46. Give the date and origin of International Yoga Day. (2 marks)

47. Give three safety measures to observe during festivals. (3 marks)

48. Explain the meaning of Ahimsa and give two ways to practise it. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Space
   Akash is the open sky or space that holds everything.

2. C — Hinduism
   Both are honoured especially in Hindu tradition.

3. A — Buddhism
   The Buddha became enlightened under a Bodhi tree.

4. C — To compare seeds with water and seeds without water
   Comparing shows that water is needed for growth.

5. B — King Suddhodana
   Siddhartha's father was King Suddhodana.

6. D — Not hurting any living being
   Ahimsa is non-violence in thought, word and action.

7. A — Pride and cruelty do not last
   Good defeats pride in the story.

8. C — A teacher who leads from darkness to light
   A guru is a teacher and guide.

9. B — Stand up for the child who is troubled
   Enlightened beings teach kindness and protecting others.

10. A — Satya, always speak the truth
   Satya means truthfulness.

11. D — Varanasi
   Parshvanath was born as a prince in Varanasi.

12. C — Uttaradhyayan Sutra: Jainism
   The Uttaradhyayan Sutra is a Jain scripture.

13. C — Waving a lamp in front of the murti while singing
   It is a prayer with a lamp.

14. D — A Hindu place of worship
   A Mandir is a Hindu temple.

15. A — God cares for us like a parent and friend
   God is called our mother, father and friend.

16. C — Before meals and in the evening
   It is said before meals, at assembly and in the evening.

17. A — Listen to a teacher or recording for correct sounds
   Listening helps us say the right sounds.

18. D — Following the rules even when nobody is looking
   Fair play is integrity.

19. B — Copying another person's work and calling it your own
   Copying and claiming it is cheating.

20. C — To join or unite
   Yoga joins body, breath and mind.

21. D — The bellows breath
   A bellows pumps air into a fire.

22. A — Vajra Asana
   You start sitting on heels.

23. C — Sasankasana
   Sasankasana.

24. C — Be honest even when alone
   Honesty at all times.

25. D — King Shibi
   King Shibi saved the dove.

26. C — A song of prayer called a bhajan
   Bhajans are sung prayers.

27. C — Rebirth
   Punarjanam is being born again.

28. A — That it is the night of Shiva and Parvati's wedding or of Shiva's great dance
   Different stories are told.

29. D — Prayer, self-control and forgiveness
   These are its main themes.

30. C — Guruvaar
   Guru is Jupiter.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Man-lion, from nar (man) and simha (lion).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: Entrance, main hall, inner room (garbhagriha), spire (shikhara), bell (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: Any sensible answer, for example Ahimsa: I will not bully or hurt classmates, and I will care for plants.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the being, 1 mark for the teaching, 1 mark for a clear action.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: Self-control through fasting, faith through prayer, staying alert to do good, and thinking about our mistakes and trying to be better.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: Gayatri Mantra, Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva and Saraswati Vandana (any correct pair earns 1 mark).
   Working / marking points: Half a mark each, rounded up.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Maha Shivratri in Phalguna and Paryushan in Bhadrapada.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each and 1 mark for correct spelling.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: The Dhammapada and the Sigalovada Sutta.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: A hall, a spire, a door with steps, a bell or flag, and the murti room (any four labelled).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct feature labelled.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: Saturday, linked with Saturn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: To ask for a clear mind, good speech and love for reading, music and the arts (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

41. (4 marks)
   Answer: Draw a table with seven columns, write English and Indian names, draw the Sun, Moon and planets above their days, and decorate it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Closing taps, mending leaks, collecting rainwater, reusing water on plants, not polluting rivers (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible way.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ramayan: Hinduism. Kalpasutra: Jainism. Dhammapada: Buddhism. Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji: Sikhism.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Respect for parents and teachers, love between brothers, courage to protect others, obedience to wise guidance (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: It keeps us calm and helps the body relax.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: 21 June, chosen by the United Nations.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the date, 1 mark for the United Nations.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Adults light lamps, stay with adults in crowds, wash hands before eating, use bins, walk and do not run (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ahimsa is not harming any living being by thought, word or action. We practise it by not bullying and by caring for animals and plants.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for each example.
